text: Upon confirmation by the licensor in writing prior to the expiration of the term hereof, this Agreement may be extended for as long as may be  agreed to by both the licensor and licensee through negotiation, provided, however, that the licensee shall not have the right to decide  the extension of the term hereof.
rationale: Flag rule: one-sided obligations. "the licensee shall not have the right to decide the extension" favors the licensor.

text: The execution, validity, interpretation, enforcement and dispute resolution of this Agreement shall be governed by the PRC Law.
rationale: Flag rule: market-practice deviation. "dispute resolution... governed by the PRC Law" gives no forum or arbitration mechanism.

text: Party B may not assign its rights and obligations hereunder without Party A's consent in writing and the successors and permitted assigns of  the Parties shall be bound by this Agreement.
rationale: Assignment rule: both parties' consent required. "Party B may not assign... without Party A's consent" restricts only Party B.

text: With respect to economic losses sustained by either Party as a  result of such event, neither Party shall be liable therefor.
rationale: Liability cap rule: requires a 12-month fee cap. "neither Party shall be liable" for economic losses is mutual but has no fee-based cap.

text: THIS ENDORSEMENT AGREEMENT ("Agreement") by and between GENO AURIEMMA ("Auriemma") and BERKSHIRE BANK, a  Massachusetts savings bank with its principal place of business at 24 North Street, Pittsfield, MA 01210 ("Berkshire")(Each or both of which shall  hereinafter be referred to as the "PARTY" or "PARTIES," respectively).
rationale: Standard party identification; no deviation from market practice or one-sided obligation evident.

text: ENDORSEMENT AGREEMENT
rationale: Document title only; no substantive obligations to flag under the playbook rule.

text: a) "CONTRACT PERIOD" means that period of time commencing upon the full execution of this Agreement by both Parties and  terminating on May 31, 2016 unless sooner terminated under this Agreement.
rationale: Fixed end date "May 31, 2016" with "unless sooner terminated" is a typical term; no one-sided deviation.

text: b) "SERVICES PERIOD" means that period of time commencing upon the full execution of this Agreement by both Parties and  terminating on May 31, 2014 unless sooner terminated under this Agreement.
rationale: Services period ends "May 31, 2014", a conventional fixed term with early termination right; no deviation noted.

text: b) Auriemma grants to Berkshire the exclusive right and license (the "License Rights") to use the Auriemma Identification during the  Contract Period and throughout the Contract Territory solely in connection with the advertisement and promotion of Berkshire and the Financial  Services;
rationale: Playbook requires approval for exclusive arrangements; "exclusive right and license" granted by Auriemma to Berkshire is one-sided.

text: The License Rights are exclusive to Berkshire and may not be assigned or in any way conveyed by Berkshire without Auriemma's  express written consent, except in the event of a merger by Berkshire with another entity offering Banking Services.
rationale: Playbook requires consent of both parties; here only Auriemma's "express written consent" governs, with a merger carve-out.

text: a) The right to use the Auriemma Identification has not been previously granted nor will it be granted to anyone other than Berkshire  for use during the Contract Period within the Contract Territory in connection with the advertisement, promotion and sale of products and services  which are the same as or similar to any of the Financial Services;
rationale: Playbook requires business and legal approval for exclusivity; "will not be granted to anyone other than Berkshire" restricts endorsements.

text: b) Auriemma will not enter into any arrangement or agreement, which enables any Berkshire Competitor to be endorsed by Auriemma  (whether by using the Auriemma Identification, Auriemma providing services similar to the Endorsement Services, or otherwise) during the  Contract Period within the Contract Territory.
rationale: Playbook requires approval for business restrictions; "will not enter into any arrangement" broadly bars Auriemma's endorsement and similar services.

text: This Agreement shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the State of Connecticut.
rationale: Governing Law: "laws of the State of Connecticut" is a neutral, mutual choice, consistent with market practice.

text: Berkshire may terminate this Agreement immediately by giving Auriemma notice if (i) Auriemma dies or is prevented by injury or illness from  satisfactorily performing the obligations required by this Agreement; (ii) Auriemma is convicted of a felony or criminal offense involving  dishonesty or fraud; or (iii) Auriemma publicly disparages Berkshire and/ or its products.
Nothing herein shall prevent Auriemma  from assigning the monetary benefits (but not the obligations) of this Agreement, as he may so desire.
rationale: Anti-Assignment: "assigning the monetary benefits... as he may so desire" permits assignment without both parties' prior written consent.

text: Berkshire may not assign this Agreement,  in whole or in part, without Auriemma's written consent.
rationale: Anti-Assignment: restriction requires only "Auriemma's written consent," not both parties', so it is one-sided.

text: In the case of reorganization, merger, consolidation, or sale of all or substantially all of its  assets, any attempt to assign this Agreement other than as permitted above will be null and void.
rationale: Anti-Assignment: "null and void" applies to any assignment "other than as permitted above," so M&A exposure depends on that carve-out.
